result.question: Why was the olive tree unwilling to give up its oil to rule the trees?

readings.answer: Because its oil honors both gods and humans.
readings.support: give up my oil | by which both gods and humans are honored

readings.answer: Because ruling the trees would require giving up its oil.
readings.support: give up my oil | to hold sway over the trees

assessments.reason: It directly matches the text’s stated reason: the oil is used to honor both gods and humans, which explains the unwillingness to give it up.
It restates the condition (ruling would require giving up oil) but not the reason for the unwillingness, which the text specifies as the oil’s role in honoring gods and humans.
